shader isolation on AMD GPUs
column2: which helps to prevent data leakage

column1: between different processes.
The handler counts the number of emitted fences for each GFX and compute
ring. If there are any fences
to be run after a delay of `GFX_SLICE_PERIOD`. If there are no fences

(kfd_sch_req_count) to keep track of the number of requests to enable

the reference count is decremented. When the reference count reaches
zero
column2: a delayed work is scheduled to enforce isolation after a delay of

When a request to disable the KFD scheduler is made
checks if the reference count is zero. If it is
work for enforcing isolation and checks if the KFD scheduler is active.

column2: it sends a request to stop the KFD
